method.threshold_rule: predeclared majority coverage; no frozen-test threshold sweep

policies.content_coverage_v1: legacy top-k plus strict lexical coverage; no reranking
policies.focused_evidence_v2: query focus with literal identity, exact-subject bundles and property-specific support

source_sha256.normalization: CRLF to LF only; no other bytes changed
